faq.q: What is a titanium subsea wellhead valve block?
faq.a: A titanium subsea wellhead valve block is a precision-machined oil & gas component used in subsea christmas tree core block valve. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V ELI for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What pressure rating for titanium subsea wellhead valve block?
faq.a: Pressure rating depends on grade, wall thickness, and temperature. Grade 2 CP-Ti pipe fittings are typically rated to Class 150 (285 psi) or Class 300 (740 psi) per ASME B16.5/B16.9. Higher ratings available with Grade 5.

faq.q: How is titanium subsea wellhead valve block manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Subsea Wellhead Valve Block is manufactured using Ring forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium subsea wellhead valve block?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
